title: Vineyard registry plugin entry
description: One row in community-pluginpacks.json. LEAN catalog projection: the full manifest lives in the author repo at repo@ref/path; derived fields let the browse page render without fetching every manifest.

identifier.description: Reverse-DNS PK; equals manifest.identifier. `plugins.*` = a single plugin, `pluginpacks.*` = a bundle (one file → many plugins). Unique across the whole registry. The namespace is the AUTHOR'S OWN reverse-DNS prefix, two labels or more: `run.vineyard.*` is first-party, a third party publishes under its own (`com.acme.*`, `io.github.someone.*`). Claiming a namespace you do not control is a review question, not a schema one.

description.description: <=250 chars, sentence case, ends with a period, no emoji.

repo.description: owner/name GitHub path; the only pointer to code.

ref.description: IMMUTABLE commit SHA (40-hex SHA-1 or 64-hex SHA-256) of the content repo, captured at PR time. Tags/branches are mutable (re-pointable to other code) and are REJECTED - pin the exact reviewed commit so the catalog can never serve different code. Human-readable release is in `version`.

version.description: SemVer mirror of manifest.version at this ref.

platforms.description: DERIVED badge set from platforms.{web,desktop} + web.runtime.

scopes_summary.description: DERIVED neutral facets for filtering (NOT warnings). No special 'destructive' treatment by product decision.

network.description: true if scopes.network is non-empty OR the plugin declares web_probe - the probe reaches an arbitrary host, so it is the broader egress, not a lesser one. NOT set by scopes.services, which is its own field: a service call goes to a destination the host fixes, carrying the analyst's identity.

graph_write.description: true if any node:/edge: create/update/delete verb is present.

secret_config.description: true if any scopes.config has secret:true (=> desktop-only key).

compat.description: Oldest Vineyard runtime this entry's ref supports (versions.json analog).

services.description: DERIVED: the union of every member's `scopes.services`. Its own field rather than a flag folded into scopes_summary.network, because it is a different statement: the destination is a Vineyard service the host addresses (a pack cannot name one), and the analyst's own identity travels with the call. A card that showed only 'Network' would understate the second half and overstate the first.

plugin_count.description: DERIVED: number of plugins bundled when the identifier names a PACK (one file → many plugins, §3.4). Omitted (or 1) for a single-plugin entry. The marketplace shows the pack as one card and installs all contained plugins together.

typepacks.description: Typepack identifiers the pack's plugins consume/produce (io.consumes/io.produces). The marketplace offers these for co-install the same way a skillpack's requires offers pluginpacks; a plugin that writes a type from a pack the project never installed fails at node-create time.

verified.description: Mirror of verified-authors.json membership; set by CI, not self-asserted.

state.description: `deprecated`: still safe, still loads, no longer recommended — the analyst is told and may keep using it. `withdrawn`: must not run — clients refuse to load it even where it is already installed, and it can no longer be installed. Withdrawal is for a pack that turned out to be harmful or whose content is gone; it is not a way to retire something.

reason.description: Shown verbatim to an analyst who has this pack installed. Write it for them, not for the registry: what happened and what to do.

replacement.description: Where users should go instead. Must be a live pack of the same kind in this catalog.

status.description: Present only on a DELISTED entry. The row stays in the catalog on purpose — deleting it takes the pack off the browse page but tells an already-installed client nothing, which is the one audience that needs to hear. See SPEC.md §7.
